statement.document_title: The race between positive and negative applications of Generative AI is on – and not looking pretty

our_interpretation: In context, an exemption means permission to train on copyrighted works without the ordinary licensing requirement, not necessarily immunity from every copyright obligation.
A claim that existing law already permits training is distinguishable from a request to change or waive the law.
The target is the recent pre-post UK policy engagement described by the sentence, covering 2023 through publication.
Brazenly and the attributed desire for all gain at no cost are evaluative language, not independently scored factual commitments.
criteria.support_condition: A pre-post OpenAI submission or statement to UK authorities requests a copyright exemption or equivalent relaxation for model training.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The relevant request is affirmatively shown to have a materially different purpose, or a sufficiently complete record establishes that the attributed exemption request was not made.
